## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Decide the citation form for a decision whose issue and PR are gone. The seat suggests the landing commit, for example "retired in `b55a34647`", or dropping the pointer where the sentence stands alone. Apply it to the published sites first (the three `.describe()` strings, JSDoc, `schema-reference.md:1093`, the three pending changesets); the comment-only sites are optional. Editing a pending changeset's prose is ordinary. Keep its frontmatter byte-identical. A `@object-ui/types` patch changeset covers the `.describe()` string change.

It is worth a maintainer question whether other issue/PR numbers in this range were deleted too (only these four were probed plus the four controls). If so, one sweep card may serve better than this one.
